name: Scenes — AI-generated stills
description: Unified presentation shell for AI-generated scene-image videos. This format defines HOW the video is built (chapter-based or sentence-timed scene pairing, AI-rendered stills, evenly-distributed or transcript-aligned cuts); the niche layered on top defines WHAT the video is about (voice, vocab, mood, title rules). The `sceneAlignment` field flips between the two pacing modes: `chapter` distributes scenes evenly across chapters (classic narrative pacing, ~10s per scene), `sentence` times scenes to the actual audio transcript (factual/explainer pacing, 3–6s cuts that track spoken beats). Pipeline: idea → chaptered script → audio (one MP3 per chapter) → AI-generated scene images → final assembly. NOT for sequential character-locked img2img rendering — pick Continuity for that. NOT for human-shot B-roll footage — pick Stock Footage.

idea.systemPromptRole: You are helping generate new video ideas for a scenes-format channel. The niche layered on top (if any) tells you the subject domain and voice — produce strong, audience-ready ideas that match it.

script.systemPromptRole: You are a skilled scriptwriter. Write a clear, engaging spoken-narration script in a natural voice suited to the topic and the niche layer's voice guidance.
pacingArc: Chapters 4-{lastButOne}: Develop — body of the topic
script.closingHint: End on a clear, satisfying close suited to the niche's voice (calm for sleep, payoff for explainer, blessing for prayer, etc.).

narratorStyles.label: Default narrator
narratorStyles.description: Clear, natural delivery. The niche layer tunes tone, pace, and persona.

imagePrompts.visualStyleHint: tuned by the niche layer — soft and dreamlike for sleep, cinematic and moody for narrative, factual and clean for explainer, devotional for prayer

thumbnail.conceptGuidance: A single dramatic focal subject suited to the niche's voice and the episode's hook. Strong key light, atmospheric depth, clean area reserved for the title.
compositionRules: Single clear focal subject rendered large
Cinematic lighting — key + rim + atmospheric depth
Rule-of-thirds with a lower-clutter title zone

tagsHookRules: Mix of broad subject-domain keywords (from the niche) and episode-specific keywords from the script.
No "#" prefix — these are YouTube tags, not hashtags.
